testResults.name: instruction-file-contract
testResults.result: .github/instructions/source-documentation.instructions.md exists with applyTo: "src/**" frontmatter matching sibling instruction files; mandates a README.md in every src/ folder covering subfolder purpose/boundaries and slice architecture/design decisions, an exact purpose statement for every code file at that folder level, and same-change README updates on add/remove/rename/repurpose; AGENTS.md references it alongside the other .github/instructions entries; initial README authoring for existing folders is explicitly out of scope per the task
